project.visitorDecision: Distinguish Kennedy Space Center from Cape Canaveral for an actual selected mission, verify pad-specific KSC Gantry restrictions, and carry the same mission from the national launch atlas into the Florida viewing/map desk.
project.primaryAction: Select the real next scheduled mission for one Florida launch facility and read live NPS/KSC access evidence separately from schedule and spectator weather.

claims.subject: launch-viewing-eligibility
claims.limitation: LC-39A and LC-39B are excluded from Gantry viewing; other pads are not automatic ticket approval.

claims.subject: playalinda-range-access
claims.limitation: Published restrictions and site policy, not proof that any individual numbered lot is currently open.

claims.subject: selected-mission-location-id
claims.limitation: Location IDs 27 and 12 are interpreted only from the shared cached schedule; no current selected live launch is asserted in this release record.

claims.subject: ksc-mission-ticket-availability
claims.limitation: KSC mission viewing is verified elsewhere in the existing specialist; this facility panel alone never claims tickets or public access.

decisionState.sourceOfTruth: Shared national LL2 Postgres schedule -> /api/space-coast-launch -> floridaLaunchNetwork() facility groups; existing selected launch UUID drives KSC, NPS, media, weather, GIS, and Launch Truth desks.
decisionState.unavailableBehavior: Disable facility switches with no scheduled mission, retain source links and existing map fallback, explicitly disclose unverified launch location, tickets, NPS access and forecasts.
